thread:
mia: Quick update for everyone — ISO & SOC evidence upload window closes next Friday, BUT we've approved a one-week extension for teams with active rollout blockers. If you need the extension, file the 'Short Extension' form by EOD Wed. Link: https://confluence.redwood.com/compliance/iso-soc-attestations

olivia: Thanks Mia. Question: do we still accept screenshots for endpoint config, or do you need exported configs?

mia: Prefer exported config files (YAML/JSON) + a one-line explanation. Screenshots ok only as supplemental evidence. Upload primary artifacts to s3://rdw-infra/compliance/iso-2026/<team>/ and name files like teamname_artifact_YYYYMMDD.ext. Also include a tiny metadata file next to each artifact named <artifact>-meta.json with owner & env. Example:
```json
{"owner":"olivia","env":"staging","ttl":"7y"}
```

devops: Heads-up — we're automating a verification pass on Thursday morning. Evidence without metadata will be flagged as "missing owner" by the scanner.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: completion of the 20-min course "Audit Ready: Evidence & Retention" is required for evidence owners by next Tue. Course link: https://learn.redwood.com/courses/audit-ready

tom: If a team member is OOO next week, can someone else be assigned as evidence owner?

mia: Yes — assign a deputy in the attestation form and update the metadata file. The scanner follows the owner field in the metadata JSON.

security-bot: Note from SecOps: any artifacts that include customer PII must be redacted before upload. If redaction isn't possible, request a secure-handling exception and we'll provide an SFTP intake process.

olivia: :white_check_mark: Uploaded api-config-20251201.json and api-config-meta.json to s3://rdw-infra/compliance/iso-2026/api-team/. Filed an extension form for the cert rotation delay (submitted to compliance-bot).

compliance-bot: Extension request received for api-team — auto-routing to @mia for approval. Reminder: include expected remediation date and approver email or request will be rejected.

mia: I'll review the extension requests Wed morning and publish a consolidated outstanding evidence list on Confluence by Wed PM. If anyone wants a quick pairing session to package artifacts, reply here and we'll schedule 15 min. Thanks all :slightly_smiling_face:
